sections.label: an elegant acoustic string quartet playing a slow wedding processional
nervous pizzicato plucked strings of a string quartet, anxious and comic
one quiet sustained high violin note with soft tremolo
a string quartet resolving warmly into a joyful major chord ending

_note: EP09 teleport rings, score A (13 Nov 2026): processional to the first beat of the story, nervous pizzicato 2.8-31.0, held violin 31.0-38.0, resolve from 38.0 with its final chord near 44.6 and a ring-out to 46.5. Score B is the same 3.0 s later.
